This name could signify a deep faith, a strong foundation in God, and the ability to wield the power of the Holy Spirit to protect and defend one’s beliefs and values. Additionally, the name could be seen as a reminder to always be prepared to stand up for truth and righteousness, to be a defender of the faith, and to use one’s God-given talents and abilities to serve and protect others.
